digest.component_or_area: reconciler dispatcher (non-create family routing through coordinator and fuse)
propositions: Non-create operation families (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict) must route through coordinator and fuse behind a per-family selector with internal legacy rollback, never dual-sending.
Matching remaining work must be deferred with explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata while independent scopes continue unblocked.
Applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies must be exact and persist non-zero degraded-pass signaling through the fuse outcome.

All legacy batch-precondition guards (lost-lease abort_check, HEAD-drift recheck, cross-project guard, blast-radius guard) and per-mutation guards must be preserved in the execute closure in the same order and safety position as the legacy loop.
Historical replay of 1,200 completed runs must prove zero premature termination of observed successful or partially successful jobs under the new fuse.
